_nota: Escenas para scripts/ilustraciones.py (ilustraciones de /servicios/). La clave es el id de la imagen: <categoría> o <categoría>--<servicio en slug>. Escenas en inglés, sin letras, pantallas ni marcas.

diseno.escena: A designer's desk seen from above: cut paper shapes, a pen nib, color swatch chips fanned out and a half-finished geometric emblem made of paper pieces, hands arranging the last piece.

diseno--branding-identidad.escena: A single bold paper emblem (an abstract geometric mark) being stamped onto a cream card, with a small row of color chips beside it.

diseno--diseno-digital.escena: Several floating rounded-square paper cards of different sizes arranged like a social media grid, one glowing in flame orange, a hand placing it.

diseno--print-impresion.escena: A small stack of freshly printed cards and a folded flyer coming out of rollers of a press, ink droplet in flame orange.

diseno--diseno-editorial.escena: An open magazine with blank columns and a large abstract photo block, pages fanned, a ribbon bookmark in flame orange.

fotografia.escena: A modern mirrorless camera with a completely plain body (no nameplate, no writing) resting on a table in a beam of warm light, a few printed photographs scattered in front, a hand reaching for one.

fotografia--fotografia-para-todo-tipo-de.escena: A camera lens reflecting string lights and confetti, silhouettes of people celebrating seen from behind.

fotografia--quinceaneros.escena: A tiara resting on a folded ball gown fabric next to a camera, soft spotlight from above.

fotografia--eventos-sociales.escena: A birthday cake with a single candle and a camera leaning beside it, balloons drawn as simple paper circles.

fotografia--corporativo-marca.escena: A product box on a seamless paper backdrop lit by a softbox, a camera on a tripod pointing at it.

fotografia--retratos.escena: A large window light falling on an empty wooden stool, a camera on a tripod waiting, a single flower in a vase.

videografia.escena: A cinema camera on a small slider rail, a film reel and a clapperboard with blank slate, warm projector beam crossing the scene.

videografia--video-de-boda.escena: Two wedding rings on a film strip, with a soft beam of projector light and petals.

videografia--quinceaneros.escena: A cinema camera filming a spinning ball gown silhouette, motion trails drawn as paper ribbons.

videografia--reels-contenido.escena: A smartphone shape made of blank cream paper standing vertical on a small tripod, a hand framing it, a flame orange play-shaped paper triangle floating.

videografia--corporativo-marca.escena: Full-bleed scene, no border or frame: an empty office chair facing a cinema camera on a tripod, a softbox light glowing warm, a small microphone on a stand, dark room.

videografia--documental.escena: Full-bleed scene: a videographer seen from behind with a camera on the shoulder, facing a winding mountain road at dusk; the landscape drawn only in near-black and cream tones with a flame orange sunset line, no green.

booth360.escena: A round rotating platform with a camera arm sweeping around it, motion arcs drawn as glowing flame orange paper ribbons, party lights in the dark.

booth360--360-video-booth-eventos.escena: A circular platform seen from above with a curved arm spinning around it, confetti and a light trail making a full circle.

booth360--360-booth-bodas.escena: A couple's silhouettes holding hands on a round platform while a light trail circles them, petals in the air.

booth360--360-booth-corporativo.escena: A round platform in front of a blank backdrop wall with geometric shapes, a light trail circling, stage spotlights.

desarrollo.escena: Paper wireframe blocks being assembled into a website layout on a desk, a mechanical keyboard drawn as simple shapes, a flame orange thread connecting the blocks.

desarrollo--plataformas-web.escena: Stacked layers of cream paper panels forming a layered website architecture, connected by thin flame orange lines.

desarrollo--apps-herramientas.escena: A toolbox opened to reveal paper gears, sliders and toggle switches made of cut paper.

desarrollo--e-commerce.escena: A small paper shopping bag next to a paper card and a tiny cardboard shipping box, a flame orange thread tying them.

desarrollo--ventanilla-pagos-con-ath-mov.escena: A small shop window (ventanilla) with an awning made of paper, a hand passing a blank card through it, a flame orange spark of confirmation.
